caption: The drawing features a single jar or pot centered in the upper half of an otherwise empty beige background. The jar is outlined in black and is relatively simple in form, with a broad body that tapers at the bottom and expands slightly at the top. It has two small, curved handles on each side, both accented with light blue shading. Near the top of the jar, the text "D. MORGAN N. YORK" is written in uppercase letters in black. Below the text, there is an oval emblem or motif with two ribbon-like shapes extending from each side, all shaded in blue. There are no other objects, patterns, or embellishments on the jar or on the rest of the page. The overall composition is minimal, with the jar situated on a mostly plain, off-white or light tan background.
title: Crock
